items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glaser run everything. See, all the orders come from Joe Glaser.

ctx.x: Well, tell me something about those road trips that you took with Louis in fronting the Russell band.

Well, with the Russell band we did a lot of hard playing. We didn't draw many people. Consequently, we didn't make much money. And with Louis, we drew a lot of people, but we wasn't gettin' much salary! But the salary we was gettin' was much more than we ever made with Russell's band, because with Russell's band it was a hit and miss thing.

See, with Louis' band it wasn't...you weren't gambling. You got so much a night. I mean, when you worked, you got paid so much a night, and you didn't have to worry about your money if the people come in or not. Which the people were always there. In fact, they had... The band's salary meant nothing. It was absolutely nothing, what they had to pay for the band to come into the place. Oh, they cleaned up some money, Joe Glaser and whoever was with him. They cleaned up oodles of money. Joe Glaser got rich off that…
